name: 巡检计划与上次完成时间
content:
WITH plans AS (SELECT i.c_device deviceKey,v.c_deviceName deviceName,
        p.dInspectionMaintenancePlanId planId,p.c_planName planName,
        p.c_xunjianzhibiao cycleCode,p.c_jihualeixing planType,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_dinspectionmaintenanceplan p2
         WHERE p2.isDeleted=0 AND p2.c_planName=p.c_planName) sameNameCount
        FROM t_dinspectionmaintenanceplan p JOIN t_inspectiondevice i
        ON i.mdDInspectionMaintenancePlanId=p.dInspectionMaintenancePlanId AND i.isDeleted=0
        JOIN t_devicemanagement v ON v.deviceManagementId=i.c_device AND v.isDeleted=0
        WHERE p.isDeleted=0 AND p.c_jihualeixing IN (1,2)
        AND i.c_device IN ('0001567-0d546da083404d689ccb5270254f4986','0001567-0d8b8beb96a7437185ee4ec2b307b133','0001567-1080e120bada4139bac3a9e29443b539','0001567-18f3f1c5f2874e8db3434b02c61055a4','0001567-1de1cce66ae84554929bbedcba548b3d','0001567-2227c1d8e09749c99557f251ac93afe1','0001567-2838347eb276479bbb75018e98bac4b7','0001567-2adce1a7bb454828a312185d4f07d344','0001567-2b3b6be1388d46c9b2ba75378a421fba','0001567-3b3ebc4911774f069b65a08ffabf03b5','0001567-4bd2a5151fc44e89bc5cb2781d87c7cb','0001567-5780ab52fc0746c6ad97ae8db6695776','0001567-5e088c31b145431980ac690cee3981dd','0001567-6cb6cc0f56974639af022cabcdddaccc','0001567-7e836097cfda42818c0d58315e8473af','0001567-84bce3b6a55c4caab52aaf1ce2230c2d','0001567-86cc8ee2e79b479aa1fcd1142df991b8','0001567-8f825b609c124b66a2ae9b6328bd3e64','0001567-91ae2dcf786c41889e5f3069cbe15ff1','0001567-92fc6ba2e8324c728d683bf0e27626ef','0001567-97204e30725d4d46b93b016a7795a779','0001567-a87fb0db4f864eb4a996da0ab49761c9','0001567-ad510b1cab1b46e3a947104af63642e4','0001567-bdb5b8d174ef404abfb1bbfc4537b782','0001567-ca64d6ba125445b8bd72e0a735f1afc4','0001567-ce6009b3fbfe430897987101421486b6','0001567-d6bf0ac1428141aa889243c859387f84','0001567-dbd388c5196d4bcaa5a10b11bc12f90f','0001567-e0cef5e6c4354433a20d92297b45d2a4','0001567-efaa56c92bef43edb1f5637df367ec3b','0001567-eff59d873a7a47a195572814fa49ae97','0001567-f75482aac9b14e4489a9c82841c6cb41') AND (:deviceKey='' OR i.c_device=:deviceKey)), tasks AS (SELECT m.deviceInspectionMaintenanceId taskId,m.c_deviceId deviceKey,
        m.c_xunjianjihua planName,m.c_inspectionStatus taskStatus,m.c_recordTime recordedAt,
        MAX(CASE WHEN m.c_inspectionStatus=1 THEN m.c_recordTime ELSE NULL END)
          OVER (PARTITION BY m.c_deviceId,m.c_xunjianjihua) lastCompleted,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.c_deviceId,m.c_xunjianjihua
          ORDER BY COALESCE(m.c_recordTime,m.createdOn) DESC,m.deviceInspectionMaintenanceId DESC) rowNum
        FROM t_deviceinspectionmaintenance m WHERE m.isDeleted=0 AND m.c_jihualeixing=1
        AND m.c_deviceId IN ('0001567-0d546da083404d689ccb5270254f4986','0001567-0d8b8beb96a7437185ee4ec2b307b133','0001567-1080e120bada4139bac3a9e29443b539','0001567-18f3f1c5f2874e8db3434b02c61055a4','0001567-1de1cce66ae84554929bbedcba548b3d','0001567-2227c1d8e09749c99557f251ac93afe1','0001567-2838347eb276479bbb75018e98bac4b7','0001567-2adce1a7bb454828a312185d4f07d344','0001567-2b3b6be1388d46c9b2ba75378a421fba','0001567-3b3ebc4911774f069b65a08ffabf03b5','0001567-4bd2a5151fc44e89bc5cb2781d87c7cb','0001567-5780ab52fc0746c6ad97ae8db6695776','0001567-5e088c31b145431980ac690cee3981dd','0001567-6cb6cc0f56974639af022cabcdddaccc','0001567-7e836097cfda42818c0d58315e8473af','0001567-84bce3b6a55c4caab52aaf1ce2230c2d','0001567-86cc8ee2e79b479aa1fcd1142df991b8','0001567-8f825b609c124b66a2ae9b6328bd3e64','0001567-91ae2dcf786c41889e5f3069cbe15ff1','0001567-92fc6ba2e8324c728d683bf0e27626ef','0001567-97204e30725d4d46b93b016a7795a779','0001567-a87fb0db4f864eb4a996da0ab49761c9','0001567-ad510b1cab1b46e3a947104af63642e4','0001567-bdb5b8d174ef404abfb1bbfc4537b782','0001567-ca64d6ba125445b8bd72e0a735f1afc4','0001567-ce6009b3fbfe430897987101421486b6','0001567-d6bf0ac1428141aa889243c859387f84','0001567-dbd388c5196d4bcaa5a10b11bc12f90f','0001567-e0cef5e6c4354433a20d92297b45d2a4','0001567-efaa56c92bef43edb1f5637df367ec3b','0001567-eff59d873a7a47a195572814fa49ae97','0001567-f75482aac9b14e4489a9c82841c6cb41') AND COALESCE(m.c_recordTime,m.createdOn)<=:asOf)
        SELECT CONCAT(p.deviceKey,':',p.planId,':cycle') recordKey,p.deviceKey,p.planId,'cycle' itemId,
        'inspection' category,p.deviceName AS `设备`,p.planName AS `计划`,
        '巡检周期' AS `检查项目`,p.cycleCode AS `周期编码`,p.sameNameCount AS `同名计划数`,
        t.lastCompleted AS `上次完成时间`,:asOf AS `参考时间`
        FROM plans p LEFT JOIN tasks t ON t.deviceKey=p.deviceKey AND t.planName=p.planName AND t.rowNum=1
        WHERE p.planType=1 ORDER BY p.deviceKey,p.planId
